_comment: Gateway Deployment env for the optional custom theme's deployment defaults (served by /api/theme-default-logo). Applied by scripts/rollout_dsh_sources.py gateway (Pipeline 1315 [deploy-dsh-gateway]); only these names are ever set, https links only. LOGO = the wide logo; MARK = the square emblem for the collapsed rail and the new-chat heading. The two LOGO values codify what the live gateway already serves; the MARK files are published by the documentation release under /manual/brand/. A MARK that fails to load falls back to a crop of the LOGO in the browser.
